english.notes:
(i) No proceedings are to be brought for an offence under this regulation in England and Wales except by or with the consent of the Secretary of State or the Director of Public Prosecutions.
(ii) For the definition for 'firm' see section 1173 of the Reports on Payments to Governments Regulations 2014.
(iii) This is the aggravated form of this offence, for the basic form of this offence see H101614.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:None
